illustration_style: Original woodland winter greeting-card illustration with a single red fox delivering a small parcel through a snowy pine grove; hand-painted storybook watercolour with subtle ink detailing.
line_weight: Fine, varied pencil-and-ink accents; delicate directional marks for fur, needles and parcel ribbon, with no heavy outlines.
line_quality: Organic, softly broken and hand-rendered contours that dissolve naturally into watercolour edges.
detail_level: Medium detail: a clear focal fox with tactile fur and knitted scarf, supported by simplified layered trees, snowdrifts, stars and a few restrained festive details suitable for reliable home printing.
character_language: Broadly believable but gently charming fox anatomy, three-quarter side view in a walking pose; alert ears, small dark eyes, soft expression and an oversized russet tail. The fox wears a plain burgundy knitted scarf and carries a tiny wrapped kraft-paper parcel tied with a forest-green ribbon.
background_density: Airy winter woodland vignette. Pale ivory sky, softly receding blue-grey pine silhouettes and rounded snowbanks leave generous uncluttered space in the upper third for a greeting added during layout.
composition: Portrait folded-card front, with the fox walking across the lower middle of the artwork from left to right. A loose crescent of snow-dusted pine boughs and faint falling snow frames the focal character without creating a border; preserve a clean upper-third text area.
palette: Muted russet and warm brown fox tones; pine green, blue-grey and soft sage shadows; creamy ivory snow; burgundy scarf; forest-green ribbon; restrained antique-gold star flecks.
shading: Layered translucent watercolour washes, soft cool winter shadows and a gentle warm glow around a few antique-gold star flecks; no hard cel shading or large dark ink-heavy areas.
texture: Subtle cold-pressed paper grain, mottled pigment variation, dry-brush snow edges, fine fur strokes and softly granular snow specks.
mood: Tender, nostalgic, peaceful and quietly festive.
age_suitability: General family audience; suited to woodland-animal and cottagecore Christmas card buyers.
print_considerations: Designed as a high-resolution A4 and US Letter printable folded-card front. Keep important artwork within a generous safe margin, retain strong tonal separation between fox and snow, use no tiny essential details, and reserve the greeting area for crisp separately typeset text.
shared_prompt: Original printable Christmas greeting-card artwork in a hand-painted storybook watercolour style: fine irregular pencil-and-ink accents, organic softly broken contours, medium-detail believable-but-charming woodland animals, translucent mottled pigment on subtle cold-pressed paper texture, muted russet, pine green, sage, blue-grey, creamy ivory, burgundy and restrained antique-gold palette. Soft layered winter shading, dry-brush snow, delicate fur and foliage marks, gentle warm star-fleck glow, airy pale background and an uncluttered upper-third area reserved for separately added greeting text. Portrait composition, calm cosy nostalgic mood, home-print-friendly focal shapes and clear value contrast.
avoid: Any reference character, including the front-facing rabbit in a green holly hat and snowflake scarf
